svg.title: How a search finds its documents
svg.desc: Nextcloud's search sends the term, such as invoice, to Paperless Unified Search, which searches the OCR text in Paperless-ngx. Paperless answers with the documents that match, such as document 412. The app looks for a file of the archive account with the marker [P412] in its name among the files that the searching user can open. With such a file, document 412 is a result that opens the file in Nextcloud; without one, it is left out.
